## Rule

Input is a 3×3 pattern P with one fg color k. Output 9×9 fractal self-product:
`out[3h+bh][3w+bw] = k iff P[h][w]==k AND P[bh][bw]==k, else 0` (derived 2026-06-07 from officials; LIVE implements the same via tiled/upsampled bg masks).
